bounded_conclusions: The existing real-SWAP corrector is admitted at a head only a few nanometres from the predictor reference for this very short F-GC45 window.
The initial affine predictor and real corrector flux differ materially relative to the tiny flux scale at the first accepted head.
Keeping the production slope fixed while reanchoring the affine intercept to the real SWAP corrector closes the coupled residual on the second iteration.
This supports interpreting the affine term as a local predictor/corrector response object; it does not yet identify u with physical storage.
